swerc-1993.notes: Source 1 (SWERCHome.html, Wayback 2000-12-11): a general ETH 'European Division' home page of 2000, nothing about the 1993 contest; it is not a source of swerc-1993 (it might serve as a series page). Its linked PastContests.html / ProblemSetArchive.html are not in our copy.

sources.evidence: Our copy is one page, 'ACM Progamming Contest European Division' of the ETH Zurich ACM site, last modified July 2000, with links to a problem set archive, past contests and photo mirrors (SWERC97, Finals 1998-2000) and no mention of 1993.

swerc-2003.notes: QOJ's dashboard note puts the programming contest on 15 November 2003 at École Polytechnique, Palaiseau; the catalogue has 2003-11-16 and Paris. The note is QOJ's own text, not an original document. The text of the four single-problem PDFs (C, E, F, I) matches the corresponding pages of the statement booklet (s8).

swerc-2004.notes: The nine single-problem PDFs (s6-s14) print no title or letter; each was matched to its catalogue problem by its text. On s10 (E) no 'Sample Output' heading is printed; the lines 8 and 0 follow the sample input. The QOJ note links an archived event site under polytechnique.edu/icpc2005/2004/, which may be worth adding as a web source.
